UK minister defends colleague amid racism accusation

UK Immigration Minister Robert Jenrick defended party colleague Lee Anderson, who was accused of racism by another Reform UK colleague. The accusation reportedly stemmed from comments Anderson made about the Mayor of London, Sadiq Khan. Jenrick stated that Anderson's comments were not racist and that he was defending him. He also mentioned that Reform UK is seeking to regain momentum with a pledge on taxes.
